article.intro: A podcast name has two jobs: tell people roughly what they'll hear, and sound like the people making it. This **podcast name generator** mixes the two most common shapes, an adjective and a format (The Curious Hour, Late Notes) and a phrase with personality, to give you a starting point.

sections.heading: What makes a podcast name work
sections.content:
• Say what it is, or how it feels. Listeners scroll fast. A name that hints at the topic or the tone gets the click.
  • Add the topic as a subtitle. Many shows pair a short, memorable name with a descriptive subtitle in the podcast app.
  • Keep it short enough to say. Word of mouth is how most podcasts grow, so people need to remember the name after hearing it once.

sections.heading: Check it's free
sections.content:
Search Apple Podcasts and Spotify for the exact name, then check social handles and a domain. Plenty of shows share a name, which makes both harder to find. If yours is taken, add a word or a subtitle to make it your own.

Starting a YouTube channel or a blog alongside it? Try the Blog Name Generator.

faqs.question: How do I name my podcast?
faqs.answer: Pick a short name that hints at the topic or the tone, add a descriptive subtitle in the podcast apps, and check the name isn't already taken on Apple Podcasts and Spotify.

faqs.question: Can I use these names for my podcast?
faqs.answer: Yes, free and with no credit needed. Search the podcast apps first so you don't share a name with an existing show.
